copy.setupNote: Auto UV tests lower GPU voltages to reduce power use while checking performance and stability.
copy.aboutPurpose: PenguinBurner tunes your GPU to use less power while you play.
copy.targetCaution: Custom voltage or clock targets can cause instability.

notes.selectedCurve: Fallback for a selected run without a tier. A tiered selected run uses its own tier colour at 3px over a 5px plotSurface halo; other traces dim to 35% alpha.
notes.severe: Worst hitch end of the frametime warning-to-severe gradient.
notes.tierCheck: Tier colours checked with Machado CVD matrices: min pairwise CIELAB dE deutan 36.9, protan 26.4, tritan 13.4. Performance moved from #F0A04B to #F59B42 because Efficiency/Performance was 23.1 under protanopia; Balanced already passed and stays #5BB8E8.
notes.themes: Dark keeps the shipped app's neutral blue-grey surfaces (ui/theme.py); the PenguinBurner accent pins its button greens. Other accents and every light accent derive from a seed in tokens.py. Light tier colours are darker versions of the dark hues.
notes.fonts: Inter ships in fonts/ (SIL OFL 1.1). Custom uses it unless another family is picked; System uses the desktop's general font at the token sizes.
notes.systemAccent: The default accent follows the desktop (XDG portal org.freedesktop.appearance accent-color, else the Qt palette). With no desktop accent it falls back to the PenguinBurner preset, the shipped app's greens.
